4.0.1: Cars: the car now notices when the app goes away — it drops the held speed, stops the motors in the same loop and shows "Disconnected" on its own screen instead of holding the last throttle.

Cars: a power-up returns the car to its last switched router by itself, and the panel names the router it is joining plus the seconds spent trying; if the router is gone the car stays on its own hotspot instead of rebooting.

Reset car: the reset now clears the car's cloud profile too, so signing in on another phone no longer brings back the settings that were just wiped. An offline reset is retried on the next connection.
4.0.0: Version 4 is a new release line for the same app: install it over the current build and sign in — your account, orders, saved cars and settings carry over.
Cars: the slowest speed setting now moves the car instead of stopping it, a held stick reaches full speed, and a router switch shows the router being joined plus the seconds spent trying.
Reset car: the panel now clears the speed, servo, steer limit, trim, mode and status values and shows the boot defaults instead of holding the last ones.

Downloads: a dropped transfer is retried, and if Android answers "App not installed" the update panel says this phone still carries a build signed with a different key — uninstall GENUM, then open the downloaded file again.
3.4.8: Updates: if Android answers "App not installed", the update panel now says why — this phone still carries a build signed with a different key, so uninstall GENUM and install the downloaded file again; your cloud data returns when you sign in.
Downloads: the release is retried and falls back to a second transfer path, so a dropped 42 MB upload no longer leaves the update manifest pointing at the previous version.
3.4.7: Cars: the slowest speed setting now moves the car instead of stopping it, and a held stick reaches full speed instead of crawling — the speed floor and the soft-start ramp were both eating the demand.
Cars: during a router switch the OLED names the router it is joining and counts the seconds it has been trying, so a slow switch is no longer indistinguishable from one that never happened.
Reset car: the panel now clears the holding values (speed, servo, steer limit, trim, mode, status) and shows the boot defaults, instead of keeping the last values until each control was nudged.
Google sign-in says plainly when the build is missing its Google config instead of surfacing a raw SDK error.
3.4.6: The app's OLED mirror carries the same car identity and transport rows the 4WD4M / 2WD1M firmware paints.
3.4.5: Bug fixes and quality improvements across the cars, D-pad, status bar and admin screens.
3.4.4: Remote: the D-pad stays when the car connects, the status note no longer resizes the drive deck, and the control tabs read as one strip.
Cars: the 4WD4M no longer resets at the start of a cycle; the 2WD1M remembers its steering, trim and telemetry and can switch to another router.
Each car is identified by its project (4wd4mcar / 2wd1mcar) and shown once per device, not once per connection key.
Admin: the Users tab no longer duplicates cars, and each account has its own Cars, Preferences and Activity windows.
3.4.3: Fully native rebuild: native UI, native auth, shared Supabase data, in-app updates.
